Label: Developmentally Appropriate First Grade Practice
Description: Joyful, strengths-based, active learning with explicit instruction, practice, play, talk, movement, and reflection.

Label: Grade 1 English Language Arts
Description: Foundational skills, phonics, fluency, literature, informational text, writing, language, speaking, and listening.

Label: Grade 1 Mathematics
Description: Addition/subtraction, place value, measurement, data, geometry, time, fractions as equal shares, reasoning, and problem solving.

Label: Grade 1 Science and Engineering
Description: Light, sound, plants, animals, weather, Earth materials, patterns, design, observation, evidence, and safe investigations.

Label: Grade 1 Social Studies and Civics
Description: Families, communities, maps, culture, time, civic symbols, service, economics, goods/services, responsibilities, and history.

Label: Social-Emotional Learning
Description: Self-awareness, self-management, social awareness, relationship skills, responsible decision-making, confidence, repair, and persistence.

Label: Arts, Music, Drama, and Creative Expression
Description: Creating, performing/presenting, responding, connecting, rhythm, visual design, storytelling, movement, critique, and portfolios.

Label: Health, Movement, and Physical Development
Description: Fine/gross motor, balance, coordination, safe movement, nutrition, hygiene, rest, health choices, and body confidence.

Label: Tools, Technology, and Unplugged Computing
Description: Safe tool use, digital citizenship, sequence, algorithms, debugging, creative communication, and computational thinking.

Label: Portfolio, Assessment, and Communication
Description: Weekly evidence, performance checks, midterm, final, self-reflection, family communication, and teacher documentation.
